title: Pick a viral video.
lead: Every template is the shot-by-shot structure of a real viral video. Upload your images. A few minutes later the same video is ready with your product.

search.label: Search templates
search.placeholder: Search templates: category, format, product type

card.title: Add your own video
card.text: Give a file or a link. In 2–5 minutes it becomes a template only you can see.

add.lead: We extract the video's structure shot by shot. In 2–5 minutes it becomes a template only you can see; upload your product and generate.
add.dropHint: mp4 or mov · up to 60 sec · up to 100 MB · vertical (9:16)
add.firstOnly: Only the first file was taken. Add the other videos one by one.

notes.structure: Only the structure is taken. The video's footage, voice, and music are never used in the output.
notes.experimental: This template has no ready sample; its card says "experimental" and the result has not been verified in advance.

error.linkInvalid: Only TikTok and YouTube video links work. Paste one of those, or upload the file.
error.failed: The link could not be added. Try again.
error.tooManyPreparing: Wait until your other videos are ready (up to 3 at a time).
error.limit: You reached the limit of 20 videos. Delete one to add another.
error.type: This file type is not supported. Use mp4 or mov.
error.size: This file is larger than 100 MB.
error.length: This video is longer than 60 seconds. Pick a part of it, up to 60 seconds; the video itself can be at most 5 minutes.
error.sourceLong: This video is longer than 5 minutes. Use a video of up to 5 minutes.
error.range: Pick a part of 3 to 60 seconds, from the start to the end. For a file, it must lie inside the video.
error.ratio: This video is not vertical. Use a 9:16 video.
error.unreadable: This file could not be read. Export it again and retry.
error.linkNotFound: We could not open this link. Check that it is correct.
error.private: This video is private. Make it public or upload the file.
error.removed: This video is no longer available.
error.unsupportedSite: We can read TikTok and YouTube links. For other sites, upload the file.
error.dailyLimit: You reached today's limit for your own videos. Try again tomorrow.
error.paused: Generation is paused for a short time. Nothing was charged. Try again later.
error.priceChanged: The price changed. Nothing was charged. Try again.
error.uploadQuota: You added many videos today. Try again tomorrow.
error.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
error.uploadServer: The file could not be saved on our side. Nothing was charged. Try again in a minute.
error.uploadTimeout: The upload took too long. Check your connection and try again.

add.added: Added. It appears under "Your templates" while it is prepared.
add.yoursEmpty: Videos you add show up here.
add.linkHint: Public TikTok or YouTube Shorts link
add.costNote: Preparing a template costs {credits}. You confirm before anything is charged.
add.checking: Checking the link. Nothing is charged for this check.

confirm.title: Prepare this template
confirm.note: You are charged when you confirm. If the template cannot be prepared, the credit comes back.

range.use: Use only a part of the video
range.hint: Write m:ss or seconds, for example 0:30 and 1:20. 3 to 60 seconds.
range.longHint: Longer than 60 seconds? Up to 5 minutes works if you pick a part of up to 60 seconds.
range.fileLong: {name} is {length} long. Pick the part to use.
range.fileLongUnknown: {name} is longer than 60 seconds. Pick the part to use.

error.format: Write the time as m:ss or in seconds, for example 0:30.
error.order: The end must come after the start.
error.short: Pick a part of at least 3 sec.
error.long: The part can be at most 1 min.
error.outside: The part must lie inside the video (it is {length} long).

add.checkingFile: Checking the file. Nothing is charged for this check.

reason.split-screen: This video uses a split screen, and the system can't build that structure yet. Your credit was returned.
reason.bad-range: We could not use the part you picked. Your credit was returned. Pick the part again, between 3 and 60 seconds, inside the video.
reason.too-long: This video is longer than allowed (60 seconds as a whole, 5 minutes when you pick a part). Your credit was returned. Add it again and pick a part of up to 60 seconds, from a video of up to 5 minutes.
reason.source-unavailable: We could not open this link: the video may be private, removed, or the link mistyped. Your credit was returned. Check the link, or upload the file.
reason.unknown: The system can't build a template from this video. Your credit was returned.

empty.title: No templates for “{query}” yet.
empty.titleFilters: No templates match these filters yet.
empty.text: Try a broader word or another category. Or give us a video you like: in 2–5 minutes it becomes a template only you can see.
empty.textNone: Give us a video you like: in 2–5 minutes it becomes a template only you can see.
empty.textNoneVisitor: We are preparing the first ready templates. They will appear here.
empty.textNoneOwn: The videos you added are under “Your templates”. Add another any time.

detail.frameAlt: Frame from the sample video of the {title} template
detail.caption: Sample video. Real output generated by this system; your video comes out with the same structure.
detail.privateCaption: Only you can see the video you added. The sample appears here after your first video from this template.
detail.privateCaptionFailed: Only you can see the video you added.
detail.privateLead: Made from the video you added. The structure was read automatically, so look over the shot list before you generate.
detail.untested: We have not tested this template. The first video can differ from your reference more than a gallery template does.
detail.preparing: We are still reading this video's structure. Cloning opens when it is ready.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this template? It cannot be brought back.
detail.deleteInUse: A video is being made from this template. Delete it once the video is ready.
detail.deleteFailed: The template could not be deleted. Try again.
detail.promise: The structure stays the same: shots, order, timing and on-screen text. People, setting and music are made new around your product.
detail.rights: You confirm you have the right to use this video as a reference.

player.subtitle: Sample video, generated by this system · reference {views} views

error.title: Could not load the gallery.
error.text: Check your connection and try again. Your videos and credits are not affected.
